text: {"label":"Differential Reinforcement and Treatment Relapse","definition":"Research on differential reinforcement procedures (alternative, other, low-rate behavior), with or without extinction, for reducing problem behavior, and on resulting persistence, resurgence, and renewal in basic and applied studies.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on differential reinforcement as a behavior-reduction treatment and later relapse, rather than general response–reinforcer relations, basic positive and negative reinforcement, or reinforcement delays."}
